info.title: EduBridge AI Backend
info.description:
EduBridge AI Backend — Learning Without Communication Barriers.

Inclusive multimodal learning platform featuring Indian Sign Language (ISL) recognition, Gemma 4 AI Tutor integration, 3D avatar animation pipelines, AAC, and multi-disability accessibility.
